svg.font-family: Amazon Ember, Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: AI travel and aviation agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, delivered on WhatsApp through AWS End User Messaging Social
2 Meta delivers it to AWS End User Messaging Social
3 End User Messaging Social publishes the event to Amazon SNS
4 SNS invokes the whatsapp_eum Lambda (dedupe, session, read receipt)
5 Lambda gets a Cognito token and invokes AgentCore Runtime
6 Agent loads Memory and gets an OAuth token from Identity
7 Agent calls tools through AgentCore Gateway (MCP)
8 AgentCore Policy authorizes each tool call (Cedar)
9 Targets: tools Lambda, Google Places, Tavily, live data APIs
